title: Maximum Number of Pairs in Array
key_insight: 统计每个数字出现次数，pairs数为count//2的总和，剩余为count%2不为0的个数
approach: Count frequency, pairs = sum(count//2), leftovers = sum(count%2)
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def numberOfPairs(self, nums):
        from collections import Counter
        cnt = Counter(nums)
        pairs = sum(v // 2 for v in cnt.values())
        leftovers = sum(v % 2 for v in cnt.values())
        return [pairs, leftovers]

title: Minimum Costs Using the Train Line
key_insight: 维护两条线路的最小代价dp，每站可选择换线或不换线
approach: DP on two rail lines with optional switching at each stop
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minimumCosts(self, regular, express, expressCost):
        n = len(regular)
        r, e = 0, expressCost
        ans = []
        for i in range(n):
            nr = min(r + regular[i], e + express[i])
            ne = min(r + regular[i] + expressCost, e + express[i])
            r, e = nr, ne
            ans.append(min(r, e))
        return ans

code_python3:

WITH invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT invoice_id, SUM(p.price * pu.quantity) AS total
    FROM Purchases pu
    JOIN Products p ON pu.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY invoice_id
)
SELECT product_id, quantity, price * quantity AS price
FROM Purchases pu
JOIN Products p ON pu.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE invoice_id = (SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_totals ORDER BY total DESC, invoice_id LIMIT 1)

title: Count Number of Bad Pairs
key_insight: bad pair条件j-i != nums[j]-nums[i]等价于nums[j]-j != nums[i]-i，用哈希表计数good pairs
approach: Transform: count pairs where nums[i]-i == nums[j]-j (good), subtract from total
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def countBadPairs(self, nums):
        from collections import Counter
        cnt = Counter()
        good = 0
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            key = x - i
            good += cnt[key]
            cnt[key] += 1
        n = len(nums)
        return n * (n - 1) // 2 - good

title: Minimize Maximum Value in a Grid
key_insight: 按原始值排序，贪心地给每个位置分配尽量小的值，同时维护行列最大值
approach: Sort cells by value, greedily assign min possible keeping row/col constraints
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minScore(self, grid):
        m, n = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        cells = sorted((grid[i][j], i, j) for i in range(m) for j in range(n))
        row_max = [0] * m
        col_max = [0] * n
        ans = [[0]*n for _ in range(m)]
        for _, i, j in cells:
            val = max(row_max[i], col_max[j]) + 1
            ans[i][j] = val
            row_max[i] = val
            col_max[j] = val
        return ans

title: Maximum Segment Sum After Removals
key_insight: 逆向处理：从空数组开始逐个加入元素，用并查集维护连通段和
approach: Reverse process: add elements back with Union-Find tracking segment sums
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumSegmentSum(self, nums, removeQueries):
        n = len(nums)
        parent = list(range(n))
        seg_sum = [0] * n
        active = [False] * n
        max_sum = 0
        ans = [0] * n
        def find(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x
        def union(a, b):
            nonlocal max_sum
            ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
            if ra == rb:
                return
            parent[ra] = rb
            seg_sum[rb] += seg_sum[ra]
            max_sum = max(max_sum, seg_sum[rb])
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            ans[i] = max_sum
            idx = removeQueries[i]
            active[idx] = True
            seg_sum[idx] = nums[idx]
            max_sum = max(max_sum, nums[idx])
            if idx > 0 and active[idx-1]:
                union(idx, idx-1)
            if idx < n-1 and active[idx+1]:
                union(idx, idx+1)
        return ans

title: Find the K-Sum of an Array
key_insight: 最大子序列和为所有正数之和，用最小堆逐步减去最小的组合得到第k大
approach: Max sum = sum of positives; use min-heap to enumerate k-th largest subsequence sum
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def kSum(self, nums, k):
        import heapq
        max_sum = sum(x for x in nums if x > 0)
        abs_nums = sorted(abs(x) for x in nums)
        # Min heap of (subtracted_amount, index)
        heap = [(abs_nums[0], 0)]
        sub = 0
        for _ in range(k - 1):
            sub, i = heapq.heappop(heap)
            if i + 1 < len(abs_nums):
                heapq.heappush(heap, (sub + abs_nums[i+1], i+1))
                heapq.heappush(heap, (sub - abs_nums[i] + abs_nums[i+1], i+1))
        return max_sum - sub

title: Maximum Rows Covered by Columns
key_insight: 枚举所有cols列的子集（大小为numSelect），计算覆盖的行数
approach: Enumerate all subsets of columns of size numSelect, count covered rows
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maximumRows(self, matrix, numSelect):
        from itertools import combinations
        m, n = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
        row_masks = [sum(matrix[i][j] << j for j in range(n)) for i in range(m)]
        ans = 0
        for cols in combinations(range(n), numSelect):
            col_mask = sum(1 << c for c in cols)
            covered = sum(1 for r in row_masks if r & col_mask == r)
            ans = max(ans, covered)
        return ans
